text: 记得当年他只是个一穷二白的臭小子嘛？
en: Remember when he was just a penniless, good-for-nothing young lad, eh?

text: 他特想看到你开心的样子，偷偷用省下来的生活费和做兼职赚的银子为你买了玫瑰花。
en: He really wanted to see you happy, so he secretly used the living expenses he'd saved up and the money he earned from his part-time job to buy you roses.

text: 你笑他买花太土，他羞涩地傻笑。
en: You laughed at him for buying flowers that were too tacky, and he just gave an embarrassed, silly grin.

text: 而兼职到深夜的疲惫，都被他藏进了陪他走夜路的路灯里。
en: And the exhaustion from working part-time until late at night was all hidden by him in the street lamps that kept him company on his night walks.

text: 记得你们在一起的第一个纪念日嘛？
en: Remember your first anniversary together?

text: 你们约好了一起庆祝，不料他为了赶一个工作项目忙得要死，迟到了一个小时。
en: You'd agreed to celebrate together, but unexpectedly, to rush a work project, he was rushed off his feet and turned up an hour late.

text: 你发了五分钟的脾气，他哄了五小时。
en: You sulked for five minutes; he spent five hours coaxing you round.

text: 为了补回这些工作时间，他加班了通宵。
en: To make up for that lost work time, he pulled an all-nighter.

text: 清晨，他偷偷亲吻了你熟睡的脸颊又西装革履地出门了。
en: At dawn, he secretly kissed your sleeping cheek, then went out smartly dressed in a suit.

text: 而那些无声的宽容和宠爱，都藏进了早餐为你烤好的面包里。
en: And that silent tolerance and affection were all hidden in the bread he'd baked for your breakfast.

text: 记得那次你们闹分手吗？
en: Remember that time you two broke up?

text: 他在外并无喜悲示人，依旧成熟、精明、干练。
en: Out in the world he showed neither joy nor sorrow, still mature, shrewd, and capable.

text: 而回到家，他望着空荡荡的房间，像一个无助的小男孩，打开、关闭、打开你们的微信对话框，反反复复。
en: But back home, he looked at the empty room like a helpless little boy, opening, closing, opening your WeChat chat window, over and over again.

text: 那些对你深沉的爱恋和不敢示人的脆弱，都被藏进了床边七扭八歪的空酒瓶里，和深夜梦见你时，无声滑落的泪珠里。
en: That deep love for you, and the vulnerability he dared not show anyone, were all hidden in the crooked, empty liquor bottles by the bed, and in the silent tears that slid down his face when he dreamt of you late at night.

text: 记得上次他回家后的样子吗？
en: Remember how he looked the last time he came home?

text: 即使他在外陪客户喝了一天酒，被酒桌上老谋深算的狐狸们刁难了一万次，
en: Even though he'd spent the whole day drinking with clients, and been made things difficult for a thousand times by those crafty old foxes at the banquet table,

text: 也会在进家门前把脸庞捏成一颗灿烂的微笑。
en: he would still mould his face into a brilliant smile before stepping through the door.

text: 把沧桑和风霜，全部隔绝在门外。
en: Keeping all the weariness and hardship shut out beyond the door.

text: 男人看似真实一面的形象，永远是那个笑如春风的大男孩，那个无所畏惧、目光坚定的丈夫，或是那个无所不能的父亲。
en: The image a man shows as his real self is forever that big boy who smiles like a spring breeze, that fearless husband with a steady gaze, or that all-powerful father.

text: 而真正真实的一面呢？
en: And what of his truly real self?

text: 那些逞强掩盖的脆弱和伤口，就被安放在路灯、面包、酒瓶、泪珠，和家门外～～～
en: Those vulnerabilities and wounds covered up by his putting on a brave face are placed in the street lamps, the bread, the liquor bottles, the tears, and outside the home~~~

text: 每个男人心中都有一个小男孩，
en: Every man has a little boy in his heart,

text: 小男孩很努力地去修炼成守护爱人的大英雄，他在路上披荆斩棘，升级打怪，甚至九死一生，明明掉了无数只血瓶也不会让最爱的人看到伤口。
en: The little boy works very hard to cultivate himself into a great hero who protects his loved one; on the way he cuts through thorns and brambles, levels up and fights monsters, even risking death nine times out of ten, yet though he's clearly lost countless health potions, he won't let the one he loves most see his wounds.

text: 对他来说最幸福的事，是当他在战斗疲惫回城休息时，有一个真正爱他的人在等待，有一个温柔乡来休憩。
en: For him, the happiest thing is that when he returns to town weary from battle to rest, there is someone who truly loves him waiting, and a tender haven in which to recuperate.

text: 温柔乡不是粉艳三千和风花雪月，温柔乡是无限的温柔和鼓励，是小男孩用来疗伤，甚至救命的。
en: The tender haven is not three thousand powdered beauties and sentimental romance; the tender haven is boundless tenderness and encouragement, the place the little boy uses to heal his wounds, even to save his life.

text: 温柔乡是小男孩变成大英雄的学校。
en: The tender haven is the school where the little boy becomes a great hero.

text: 如果你愿意成为我的大英雄，那我也愿意保护你心中的小男孩，你做周瑜我做小乔，我们一起打怪升级灭妖，你真实的不真实的一面我都要看到～好不好～
en: If you're willing to be my great hero, then I'm willing to protect the little boy in your heart; you be Yu Zhou and I'll be Qiao Xiao, together we'll fight monsters, level up and vanquish demons, and I want to see every side of you, your real and unreal selves~ all right~

text: 他不让你看到最真实的一面，是因为爱；
en: He doesn't let you see his most real self because of love;

text: 她能看到他隐藏的真实的一面，恰恰也是因为爱…
en: and she can see the real self he hides precisely also because of love...

text: 小姐姐的镜像回答：
en: The young lady's mirror reply:

text: 女生真实的一面是什么样子的呢？
en: What does a girl's real self actually look like?

text: 请移步：https://www.zhihu.com/question/67091864/answer/259335334
en: Please head over to: https://www.zhihu.com/question/67091864/answer/259335334

text: 我吃过的最大的亏就是女人不要轻易在男人面前展现天真浪漫童趣以及雄心壮志的野心。
en: The biggest lesson I've learnt the hard way is that women should not lightly show their innocence, romance, childlike fun, and ambitious aspirations in front of men.

text: 有时候你表现出乐观积极向上的一面，就足以让一些男人对你下狠手了。
en: Sometimes, just showing your optimistic, positive, upbeat side is enough to make some men deal you a vicious blow.

text: 还有就是，不要轻易陪男人一起吃苦。
en: Also, don't lightly share hardship with a man.

text: 最后你帮他贷款，帮他搞资源，也抵不过在他最低谷的时候骂他嫌弃他的一句话。
en: In the end, even if you help him take out loans and help him get resources, it can't outweigh a single word of scolding and disdain you utter when he's at his lowest.

text: 这是我身边那些姐妹统一告诉我最大的教训。
en: This is the biggest lesson those sisters around me unanimously told me.

text: 远离低层次的男性，他跟你压根就不是一个圈层。
en: Stay away from low-tier men; he and you aren't even in the same circle.

text: 说话会有点偏激，一些男人始终没认识到自己在没发家前他老婆才是最不嫌弃他的那一个。
en: What I'm saying may sound a bit extreme, but some men never realise that before they made it big, their own wife was the one who minded him the least.

text: 男人成功后总想要得到小女孩的崇拜。
en: After a man succeeds, he always wants to win the admiration of young girls.

text: 女人呢？
en: And women?

text: 很多男人都不希望女人能成功吧？
en: Many men probably don't want women to succeed, do they?

text: 呵呵。
en: Hehe.

text: 有时候真诚善良抛出去，仅仅因为你表现出自信，就要被无情打压死。
en: Sometimes when you put out sincerity and kindness, just because you show confidence, you get ruthlessly crushed.

text: 所以女性朋友们啊，一定要取得成绩，道路虽长，但也是保证自己的权利和荣耀在自己手上。
en: So, female friends, you must achieve results; though the road is long, it is also how you keep your rights and glory in your own hands.

text: 男人啊希望自己的女儿有野心壮志，却不希望自己的妻子野心勃勃。
en: Men, ah, hope their daughters have grand ambitions, yet don't want their wives to be ambitious.

text: 女人一定要抱着我不优秀我就去死的心态拼搏。
en: Women must strive with a die-if-I'm-not-excellent attitude.

text: 请让女人有更多可能性，请让这个世界多一些女贵人。
en: Please let women have more possibilities; please let this world have more female benefactors.

text: 我希望，在女人低估时期，出现的不只有男贵人，也有女贵人。
en: I hope that in women's low periods, there appear not only male benefactors but also female benefactors.

text: 女性革命开放不过才一百年，道之所艰。
en: Women's emancipation has been going on for scarcely a hundred years; the road is hard.

text: 女性前进的路上容易遇到太多男性的恶意。
en: On the road forward, women easily encounter too much malice from men.

text: 甚至有时候不仅要面对男性的恶意，还有面对一些女性的恶意。
en: Even sometimes they must face not only the malice of men, but also the malice of some women.

text: 女性不优秀，换来的几乎永远是轻蔑，会说女人就是懒，会攻击女人的品德甚至外貌。
en: If women are not excellent, what they get in return is almost always contempt; people will say women are just lazy, and attack a woman's character and even her appearance.

text: 而男性不优秀，那些人会说大丈夫能屈能伸，来日东山再起。
en: But if a man is not excellent, those people will say a true man knows when to yield and when to stand firm, and will rise again another day.

text: 钱。
en: Money.

text: 我的脑子里只有钱。
en: My mind holds only money.

text: 你从来都不知道没钱在你面前能多自卑，所以我不会追你，也不会关心你，更不会在你生病的时候照顾你。
en: You never knew how ashamed of being broke one can feel in front of you, so I won't chase you, won't care about you, and certainly won't look after you when you're ill.

text: 我怕到医院的时候他妈的连个医药费都付不起，那时候真想跳楼一了百了。
en: I was afraid that at the hospital I fucking couldn't even pay the medical bills, and back then I really wanted to jump off a building and end it all.

text: 平常的馒头青菜你以为我爱吃？
en: You thought I actually enjoyed those plain steamed buns and greens?

text: 都是为了钱。
en: It was all for money.

text: 我真的想告诉你我一生的追求，不是和你白头好吗？
en: I really wanted to tell you — wasn't the pursuit of my whole life to grow old together with you?

text: 我只想睡在钱堆里，点烟用钱，穿的是钱，最后死在钱眼里。
en: I only want to sleep in a pile of money, light my cigarette with money, wear money, and finally die in the eye of a coin.

text: 还有，对不起。
en: Also, I'm sorry.

text: 男频小说是啥样，男人真实的一面就是啥样。
en: Whatever male-oriented novels are like, that's what a man's real self is like.

text: 一个男人跟我说过，混好了的男人很少同情失败了的男人，顶多同情一下弱女人。
en: A man once told me that men who've got ahead rarely sympathise with men who've failed; at most they'll pity a weak woman.

text: 只有女人会圣母心泛滥比如觉得路边失意的男人可怜。
en: Only women let their saviour complex run wild, for instance thinking the down-and-out men by the roadside are to be pitied.

text: 一些商界大佬，他一路上来是很坎坷的。
en: Some business tycoons had a very rough road getting to where they are.

text: 他会说自己一路有多不容易，但是同样他这一路不会同情任何除自己以外的其他男人，而且对于对手下手非常狠。
en: He'll talk about how hard his journey was, but equally he won't sympathise with any other man besides himself along the way, and he strikes his opponents very ruthlessly.

text: 男人做事保全利益为优先，哪怕错也不是他的错，他一定要当上位者不然就会被打落，这是男人世界的处事逻辑，或者说是雄性处事逻辑，又争又抢，既要又要。
en: Men act with preserving their interests as the priority; even if it's wrong, it's not his fault — he must be the one on top, otherwise he'll be struck down. This is the way men conduct themselves, or one could say the way males conduct themselves — ever contending and grabbing, wanting everything at once.

text: 男性对待他们内部的老实人是非常残忍的。
en: Men are extremely cruel towards the honest, decent men within their own ranks.

text: 他们本质都不同情同类，只是为了自我在性别立场上呈现着一种伪团结。
en: At heart they don't sympathise with their own kind; they merely put on a show of false solidarity from a position of gender.

text: 一起组局喝酒，diss女人，不妨碍他们有利益纷争的时候翻脸不认人，塑料兄弟。
en: Getting together to drink and diss women doesn't stop them from turning on each other without mercy when there's a conflict of interests — plastic brothers.

text: 比如中东国家，好像是男性团结一致压迫女人，实际上他们对自己内部的底层男人更是弱肉强食，男人死亡率很高。
en: Take Middle Eastern countries, for instance: it seems men unite to oppress women, but in reality they practise the law of the jungle even more brutally among the lower-class men within their own ranks, and male mortality is very high.

text: 强男不把弱男当人看。
en: Strong men don't treat weak men as human beings.

text: 男人对待自己爱的女性才有几分感情。
en: It is only towards the women they love that men show a bit of genuine feeling.

text: 而这个爱产生的原因就是女性对男性的怜悯同情呵护，在他们眼里非常可贵，所以有些男人会嫌天真的女人蠢。
en: And the reason this love arises is the pity, sympathy and care that women show men, which in their eyes is extremely precious — so some men find naïve women foolish.

text: 但是又喜欢天真的女人，希望所有的女人不要变聪明。
en: But they also like naïve women, and hope all women never become clever.

text: 所以女性切记一切喜欢跟女人纠缠，胡搅蛮缠的男人本质已经低价值到不能再低价值了。
en: So women must remember: any man who likes to tangle with women, who fusses and nags and won't let go, is at heart already of the lowest possible value.

text: 负能量纠缠的男人对女人的爱会变得扭曲，本质还是想得到女人关注。
en: A man who entangles himself in negative energy will have a love for women that becomes distorted; at heart he still wants women's attention.

text: 因为他们其实清楚，男人是不会真心关注和同情他们的。
en: Because they actually know clearly that men won't genuinely pay attention to or sympathise with them.

text: 但又凭什么呢，吃个饭还要看店铺评分有没有到5分呢，别瞎和负能量进行能量纠缠。
en: But what right have they, then? You even check whether a restaurant's score has hit 5 before you'll eat there — so don't go blindly entangling your energy with negative energy.
